messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: This is up to a maximum first dose of 50 mg.
Doses above 2 mg/kg have not been studied.
Doses above 200 mg a day have not been studied.
Extended-release metoprolol has not been studied in children under 6 years.
Dose adjustments:
Liver problems.
Start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly.
Kidney problems.
No dose reduction is needed.
Older adults.
A low starting dose is generally used.
This is because liver, kidney, and heart function are more often reduced.
Other medicines are more often involved.
Switching between forms.
When changing from immediate-release to extended-release metoprolol, the same total daily dose is used.
Triplet: ["Extended-release metoprolol", "has unstudied use in", "children under 6 years"]

The relation 'has unstudied use in' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has not been studied for use in the population specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
B. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
C. 'has no interaction with': The subject drug does not have a known pharmacological interaction with the object entity.
D. 'has unknown effect on': The effect of the subject drug on the entity specified by the object entity is not known.
E. 'has no identified risk of': The subject drug has no identified risk of the adverse outcome or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
